title: conophyllum niveum
intro: Conophyllum niveum, commonly known as the Snowy Conophyllum, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Conophyllum niveum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are known for their therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
